3441ccc32a645f6092c405c3bea324de1e67815d:
query FlxBackupJobRead {
  flxBackupJob {
    ...FlxBackupJobFields
  }
}

fragment FlxBackupJobFields on FlxBackupJob {
  status
  kind
  id
  phase
  percent
  text
  error
  token
  cancelled
  elapsed
  elapsedLabel
  eta
  etaLabel
  title
  sizeLabel
  result
}
48e64891298acc8e11a7b7988f76d522414a779a:
mutation FlxBackupLock($input: FlxBackupLockInput!) {
  flxBackupLock(input: $input) {
    backup {
      ...FlxBackupRow
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxBackupRow on FlxBackup {
  id
  type
  typeLabel
  typeColor
  status
  statusLabel
  title
  label
  created {
    iso
    timestamp
    label
    relative
  }
  size
  sizeLabel
  files
  includesDatabase
  contents
  source
  sourceLabel
  originalSite
  locked
  keepKind
  keepLabel
  error
  packages {
    slug
    name
    fromVersion
    toVersion
    label
  }
  downloadUrl
  percent
  progress
  running
  restore {
    id
    title
    database
    foreignSite
    prefixInBackup
    prefixOnSite
    groups {
      key
      label
      items {
        path
        label
      }
    }
  }
}
7efa2a37904f7bc808c0c94dd88aad63935b3f1b:
query FlxBackupDetail($id: ID!) {
  flxBackup(id: $id) {
    ...FlxBackupRow
    wpVersion
    originalCreated {
      timestamp
      label
    }
    finished {
      timestamp
      label
    }
    keepUntil {
      timestamp
      label
    }
    breakdown {
      raw
      zip
      categories {
        key
        label
        color
        isDatabase
        raw
        zip
        count
        items {
          name
          label
          raw
          zip
          count
        }
        moreCount
        moreRaw
        moreZip
        moreItems
      }
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxBackupRow on FlxBackup {
  id
  type
  typeLabel
  typeColor
  status
  statusLabel
  title
  label
  created {
    iso
    timestamp
    label
    relative
  }
  size
  sizeLabel
  files
  includesDatabase
  contents
  source
  sourceLabel
  originalSite
  locked
  keepKind
  keepLabel
  error
  packages {
    slug
    name
    fromVersion
    toVersion
    label
  }
  downloadUrl
  percent
  progress
  running
  restore {
    id
    title
    database
    foreignSite
    prefixInBackup
    prefixOnSite
    groups {
      key
      label
      items {
        path
        label
      }
    }
  }
}
